title: SDBench
author: Souldbminer and Lightos_
description: A simple SD card benchmarking tool
details: SDBench is a simple SD Card benchmark tool. It supports both Switch 1 and Switch 2, and can be used to determine SD card health and overall speed
changelog:
1.1.0: Improve benchmark relability and support both NX and OUNCE targets (S1/S2)
1.0.0: Initial release
